text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I did it!
I won, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, my mind went totally blank!
All I could feel was my whole body surging with energy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I had crossed the finish line.
...In first place!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha, I really...
took 1st place, didn't I...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha, I really...
took 1st place, didn't I...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"All I can probably ever do
is give it everything I've got, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'd be so happy if I could take 1st place next time too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We may have won this time, but there's no telling
what will happen in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll tighten up both my mind and my muscles,
and do my absolute best!!
